title: Simple Sides: Broccoli and Corn
description: Frozen broccoli and frozen corn, microwave, oven, or skillet.

ingredients.item: butter, salt, garlic powder, optional parmesan

steps: Broccoli, microwave (fastest): 1 to 2 cups in a covered bowl with 2 Tbsp water, 4 to 6 min, stir halfway. Drain. Toss with butter, salt, garlic powder, optional parmesan.
Broccoli, oven roasted (crispier): Air Fry mode 425°F, toss frozen florets with 1 Tbsp oil, salt, garlic powder, single layer, 15 to 20 min, stir halfway. Done when edges are browned.
Corn, microwave: 1 cup corn, 1 tsp butter, pinch salt, covered, 2 to 3 min, stir.
Corn, skillet: 1 Tbsp butter over medium-high, corn, salt, pepper, 5 to 6 min until a few kernels brown.
source: Joe's Meal Pack, Oct 20 to Nov 4, 2026 (built by Thrifty, now kept by Meal Plan), R16

healthy: Broccoli and corn add fiber and vitamins.
Steamed with only a little oil and butter.
not_healthy: Butter and optional parmesan add some saturated fat.
